# harebear-ui

> Opinionated, pre-themed React component library: shadcn/ui primitives restyled to one design system, plus admin, data, and AI chat components. React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Radix, TypeScript. Ships its Tailwind theme.

## Setup in an app

1. `npm i harebear-ui` (peers: react, react-dom 19; tailwindcss 4).
2. `npx harebear-ui init` wires the CSS import and agent docs, or do it by hand: in the main CSS file, `@import "tailwindcss";` then `@import "harebear-ui/styles.css";`.
3. Wrap the app: `<ThemeProvider><TooltipProvider>{app}<Toaster /></TooltipProvider></ThemeProvider>`.
4. Import everything from the root: `import { Button, Card, DataTable } from "harebear-ui"`.

## Rules

- Use harebear-ui components before writing new UI. Primitives keep shadcn/ui names and props.
- Style with theme tokens only: bg-background, bg-card, bg-muted, text-muted-foreground, bg-primary, bg-primary-soft, text-success, text-warning, text-destructive, border-border, shadow-card, rounded-md/lg/xl. No hex colors or Tailwind palette colors.
- Status is a tone: success | warning | danger | info | neutral.
- Icons: lucide-react elements, e.g. `<SearchIcon />`. Icon-only buttons need aria-label.
- Change the brand with `<ThemeProvider accent="#hex" radius={14}>` or `--brand` / `--radius` in CSS.

## Component index

Theme: ThemeProvider, useTheme, ThemeToggle, ThemeScript
Layout/admin: AppShell, AppBrand, PageHeader, StatCard, SearchInput, StatusDot, StatusBadge, UsageMeter, ActivityFeed, Timeline, KeyValueGrid, UserChip, Callout, LinkTile
Data: DataTable, createDataTableColumnHelper, TrendChart, TrendLegend, BarList, Sparkline, StatusBars
AI/chat: ChatThread, ChatMessage, AssistantAvatar, MessageActions, PromptInput, PromptInputChip, ModelPicker, ConversationList, ToolCall, TypingIndicator, CodeBlock, InlineCode, Prose
Primitives (shadcn/ui): Accordion, Alert, AlertDialog, AspectRatio, Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, ButtonGroup, Calendar, Card, Carousel, Chart, Checkbox, Collapsible, Command, ContextMenu, Dialog, Drawer, DropdownMenu, Empty, Field, HoverCard, Input, InputGroup, InputOTP, Item, Kbd, Label, Menubar, NavigationMenu, Pagination, Popover, Progress, RadioGroup, Resizable, ScrollArea, Select, Separator, Sheet, Sidebar, Skeleton, Slider, Spinner, Switch, Table, Tabs, Textarea, Toaster, Toggle, ToggleGroup, Tooltip
Hooks/utils: useCopyToClipboard, useIsMobile, cn
